text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Huh...
It was during the final stretch of the race that I heard that confusion.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, is this where Narita Brian makes her move?!
Still no change in the lead!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Is Narita Brian unable to find extra speed?!
Narita Brian is—!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... hah,
hyuu... haa...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
……No way.
Brian did……?

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
"...N-No.
This isn't Brian's real ability at all.
Um. Well—"

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
...That's it!
Brian was racing right after coming back from an injury, so she just wasn't in top form yet!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that might be it.
Guess next time's when you pull way ahead and win.
Man, get it together, Brian!

text_block_list.name: Spectator E
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, wasn't there something weird about the way she ran?
Like her body was way stiffer than usual..."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Tch...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: (—I'm not reflected in her eyes yet.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(Finishing order doesn't matter to Brian-chan.
All she sees
is pure, unadulterated running during the race.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...I have to shine so brilliantly
that no one can take their eyes off me.

The Monster's Sunset—
Narita Brian's run in the Tenno Sho (Autumn) was widely reported across the media.

text_block_list.name: Show News Anchor
text_block_list.text: "Let's hear an expert opinion on this. What did you make of Narita Brian's performance in the Tenno Sho (Autumn)?"

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
The decision to run in itself was hasty.
Her condition wasn't ready at all.

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
The injury must have taken a heavy toll on her.
Narita Brian can't find her old stride at all anymore.

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
...So I am honestly bewildered
by her decision to run in
next month's Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
That would be one thing for an Umamusume in peak condition.
What is she rushing for without taking a single break...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Haa... hah, whew... haa...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder if Brian-san will be okay.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"Hasn't she been losing momentum the more she runs?
Could it be that even in the Japan Cup...?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaaaaargh!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
......
Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: I want to run in the Japan Cup.

"...Running in GⅠ races two months in a row
is a proposal I never could have agreed to right away
back during the Classic year."

However, she has already
overcome the weakness in her legs.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
No matter how dark it is around me,
I want to become a light that shines brightly.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"No matter how dark and deep
the darkness shrouding Brian-chan is right now."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
If there's light, it serves as a beacon. The path becomes clear.
Instead of stumbling in the dark, you can move forward along the path.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"...I believe that becoming that light
is what makes you someone she looks up to."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"No matter how much of a long-haul battle it becomes,
I won't be discouraged. I have the temperament of a stayer, after all."

"...As if answering her gaze,
the words slipped right out of my mouth."
choice_data_list: You can show us a dream.
You can show everyone a dream.

text_block_list.text:
—Ever since my debut race,
there is a dream I still cannot forget.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Sakura Laurel takes a spectacular 1st place in the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe!!
Fulfilling Japan's long-cherished dream, she shines at the pinnacle!"
...She's someone who can give people dreams.
choice_data_list: Just like I once dreamed of you
Just as I once dreamed of you

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Yes!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"À cœur vaillant rien d'impossible."
—To a valiant heart, nothing is impossible.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"This time, I will become
a hero to that child."
Just one month left until the Japan Cup.
